title: Your Smartphone Just Became a Political Battleground: Understanding the EU's Google vs. Apple AI Standoff
angle: The EU's recent rulings, forcing Google to open Android to rival AIs while denying Apple a similar grace period, highlight a massive shift in how tech giants operate globally. This isn't just about apps; it's about who controls the future of AI on your device and why Europe is leading the charge.
rationale: This piece decodes complex geopolitical tech policies, making them relevant to everyday users and industry watchers.

source_articles.title: EU demands Google give AI rivals more access to Android
source_articles.excerpt: Google has been ordered by the EU to open up key Android handset features to rival AI voice assistants.

source_articles.title: Google is better at playing the EU regulations game
source_articles.excerpt: Today, the European Union ordered Google to give its AI rivals greater access to Android, the open-source operating system that powers billions of devices worldwide.
